## [0.4.0](https://github.com/PychronLabsLLC/pychron-cpp/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0) (2026-10-13)


### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **persistence:** a store made before this must be migrated once before pychron-ui, export, flux or entry will open it:

### Features

* **canvas:** the canvas file can name the colour behind the drawing ([c336269](https://github.com/PychronLabsLLC/pychron-cpp/commit/c336269de83763cf0bd189c03cf2d446ad2c1bd7))
* **configs:** the example lab runs simulated air shots and blanks ([a544105](https://github.com/PychronLabsLLC/pychron-cpp/commit/a5441055baf8fc8989b5e74f5c0cb4b9f66e10cb))
